## `useResources()`

<!-- What it fetches, named as its return field: "Fetches all X as `resources: Resource[]`." -->

```tsx
const { resources, isLoading } = useResources();
```

## `useResource(id)`

<!-- Inline the parameter rather than tabling it: "Fetches one X by `id` (`number | null`)." -->

<!-- Only table the return fields that are SPECIFIC to this hook. Never repeat isLoading / isError / isMutating — they are in Shared conventions. -->

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `resource` | `Resource \| null` | The fetched record, or null if not loaded |
| `updateResource` | `(arg: Partial<Resource>) => Promise<Resource>` | Mutation trigger |

```tsx
const { resource, isLoading, updateResource } = useResource(id);
```
